item.title: Show HN: ApeiroCraft – Proposals that track views, e-sign and invoice
item.summary: Hi HN, I built ApeiroCraft after getting tired of sending proposals and having zero visibility into what happened next. Clients would sometimes ignore them, sometimes open them multiple times without replying, or accept them — and I’d still have to turn everything into an invoice manually. I wanted one simple flow instead of juggling PDFs, e-signature tools, and invoicing software: Create and send a proposal Get notified when it’s opened (and how many times) Let the client review and sign online Turn the accepted proposal into an invoice with one click Why not just use a PDF? Once a PDF leaves your inbox, you lose visibility. I wanted proposals to remain interactive rather than become static attachments. Why not stitch existing tools together? You can, and a lot of people do. I just got tired of maintaining the same client and pricing info across multiple apps. Who it’s for Freelancers, agencies, and consultants who send proposals regularly and want a cleaner path from “here’s my proposal” to “here’s your invoice.” It’s still early.
